import pandas as pd

orders = pd.read_csv("data/shop/orders.csv")
items = pd.read_csv("data/shop/order_items.csv")
customers = pd.read_csv("data/shop/customers.csv")

delivered = orders[orders["status"] == "delivered"].merge(items, on="order_id")
delivered["value"] = delivered["quantity"] * delivered["unit_price"]
per_customer = delivered.groupby("customer_id", as_index=False)["value"].sum()
spend = per_customer.merge(customers[["customer_id", "first_name"]], on="customer_id")
spend["total"] = spend["value"].round(2)
spend = spend[["customer_id", "first_name", "total"]]
print(spend.sort_values("total", ascending=False).head())

import pandas as pd

def load(existing, batch):
    combined = pd.concat([existing, batch], ignore_index=True)
    latest = combined.sort_values("loaded_at").drop_duplicates("order_id", keep="last")
    return latest.sort_values("order_id").reset_index(drop=True)


existing = pd.DataFrame({"order_id": [1, 2], "status": ["shipped", "delivered"], "loaded_at": ["2026-11-01", "2026-11-01"]})
batch = pd.DataFrame({"order_id": [1, 3], "status": ["delivered", "delivered"], "loaded_at": ["2026-11-02", "2026-11-02"]})
once = load(existing, batch)
twice = load(once, batch)
print(once)
print(once.equals(twice))
py7-1.check:
import pandas as pd
_e = pd.DataFrame({'order_id': [1, 2], 'status': ['shipped', 'delivered'], 'loaded_at': ['2026-11-01', '2026-11-01']})
_b = pd.DataFrame({'order_id': [1, 3], 'status': ['delivered', 'delivered'], 'loaded_at': ['2026-11-02', '2026-11-02']})
_once = load(_e, _b)
assert _once is not None, 'remember to return the DataFrame'
assert list(_once['order_id']) == [1, 2, 3], 'one row per order_id, sorted by order_id'
assert _once.loc[_once['order_id'] == 1, 'status'].iloc[0] == 'delivered', 'keep the newest version of order 1'
assert _once.equals(load(_once, _b)), 'loading the same batch twice must not change the result'

def dedupe(rows):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        if r['order_id'] not in seen:
            seen.add(r['order_id'])
            out.append(r)
    return out

rows = [
    {'order_id': 1, 'total': 10},
    {'order_id': 2, 'total': 20},
    {'order_id': 1, 'total': 10},
]
print(dedupe(rows))
